title: Ἐγχειρίδιον περὶ μέτρων / Enchiridion (Handbook on Metres), with Περὶ ποιήματος / «Энхиридион о метрах»
author: Hephaestion of Alexandria
size: Consbruch pp. 1–73 (estimate 10–12k words). Scholia and Choeroboscus' commentary add about 300 pp.
edition: M. Consbruch, Hephaestionis Enchiridion cum commentariis veteribus (Teubner 1906; PD).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Гефестион (грамматик)) lists only the English translation. No Russian translation found.
en_evidence: J. M. van Ophuijsen, Hephaestion on Metre (Mnemosyne Suppl. 100, 1987); cited on ru.wikipedia.
value: The only complete ancient Greek metrical handbook. A source for Sappho, Alcaeus and Anacreon fragments and the basis of metrical terminology. Useful for Russian teaching of Greek verse. RU-gap.
ai_feasibility: medium: LLMs make scansion errors, so an expert metrician must review. Notation needs standardizing.
